attributes.description: Availability of the NETGEAR cable modem's Genie web interface, the DOCSIS startup procedure, modem uptime and the modem event log. Start here, then open [NETGEAR Genie] DOCSIS channels to look at the individual bonded channels.
Share of modem status polls that reached the Genie web interface and parsed the DOCSIS status page.
attributes.title: Web interface availability

attributes.description: Uptime reported by the modem on the most recent successful poll.

visualization.subtitle: Modem uptime at the last poll

attributes.title: Time since last reboot

attributes.description: Round trip time of the last DOCSIS status page request. Rising latency tends to precede the modem's web server wedging.

visualization.subtitle: Round trip of the DOCSIS status page

attributes.title: Web interface response time

attributes.description: Modem event log rows the modem marked critical, such as T3 and T4 timeouts and SYNC failures.

visualization.subtitle: Critical rows in the modem event log

attributes.title: Critical events

attributes.description: One bar per poll interval, broken down by the outcome the collector recorded: ok, unreachable, http_error, auth_failed, session_conflict or session_stuck.
attributes.title: Web interface state over time

attributes.description: Slowest DOCSIS status page request in each interval. A sustained climb usually ends with the modem's web server wedging.
attributes.title: Web interface response time

attributes.description: Uptime reported by the modem. A drop between two points means the modem rebooted.
attributes.title: Modem uptime

attributes.description: Identity of the modem from the most recent successful poll. Failed polls carry no device information, so the panel is scoped to successful polls.
attributes.title: Device information

attributes.description: The modem's startup procedure table as of the last successful poll. The downstream channel row reports its lock state in the comment and its frequency in the status.
attributes.title: DOCSIS startup procedure

attributes.description: Modem event log rows over time, broken down by the severity the modem assigned.
attributes.title: Event log volume by severity

attributes.description: T3 timeouts (82000500 unicast ranging, 82000200 ranging response) and T4 timeouts (82000400). The single most useful line health signal: a rising count means the upstream is not getting through.
attributes.title: DOCSIS ranging timeouts over time

attributes.description: DOCSIS event codes seen in the modem event log. Occurrences sums the modem's own repeat counter, which is usually much larger than the number of rows collected.
attributes.title: Top event codes

attributes.description: The most recent rows of the modem's DOCSIS event log with the message text. Occurrences is the modem's own repeat counter for the row.

query.esql:
FROM logs-netgear_genie.event_log-*
| KEEP @timestamp, log.level, event.code, message, netgear_genie.event_log.count
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 200

| LIMIT 200
